company.name: Patch Biosciences
company.shortDescription: Patch Biosciences is a synthetic biology and machine learning company with a platform to engineer gene therapies and medicine.
company.description: Patch Biosciences offers machine-designed DNA for gene therapy. They build a platform to engineer gene therapies that can address a broader range of diseases through large-scale DNA synthesis and machine learning.

productsAndServices.description: An AI platform developed by Patch Biosciences for designing genetic sequences to create more effective and durable genetic medicines.
productsAndServices.name: AI platform for sequence design

productsAndServices.description: Technologies for engineering synthetic promoters and untranslated regions, enhancing the effectiveness of genetic medicines.
productsAndServices.name: Synthetic promoter and untranslated region (UTR) engineering

productsAndServices.description: Patch Biosciences has developed muscle promoters that have been validated for use in genetic medicine applications.
productsAndServices.name: Validated muscle promoters

productsAndServices.description: Developed robust untranslated regions for RNA, contributing to the stability and efficacy of RNA-based therapies.
productsAndServices.name: Robust RNA UTRs
